# NightWeavingStatus

Where a night weaving is.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Running"` | It is running now. |
| `"Completed"` | It finished. |
| `"Failed"` | It stopped on an error (see `error`). The loom is tried again later. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`NightWeaving`](night-weaving.md)
